g.text: Pre-only bounds; 1% prediction-preservation budget. This is not an Accuracy comparison.

All 330 conditions from the other 11 graphs abstain. Moment0 shown; moment2 gives the same group decisions.
Panel B: segments are pre-only disagreement bounds; dots are later verified disagreements. Ordinary float64 audit.
